create.name: Chandrakirti Meditation Centre
create.bio:
Chandrakirti Meditation Centre is a Tibetan Buddhist centre on five acres of hill country at Upper Moutere, a short drive from Nelson at the top of New Zealand's South Island. It is part of the FPMT, the Gelugpa network founded by Lama Yeshe and Lama Zopa Rinpoche, and grew from a property cared for by its founders Bruce and Phillipa, who later gave the land to the Chandrakirti Trust. The Dalai Lama blessed the centre in 2002 and named its new meditation hall, Nalanda Hall, which is filled with images of the twenty-one Taras; the grounds also hold a stupa, a large prayer wheel and several life-size statues.

Since 2011 its resident teacher has been Geshe Jampa Tharchin, a Lharampa geshe trained at Sera Je Monastery in South India. He gives a drop-in Sunday meditation class by donation, which is streamed and archived on the centre's YouTube channel, and teaches the FPMT's five-year Basic Program in sutra and tantra on weekday evenings and teaching weekends. The summer calendar brings residential retreats with Geshe-la and visiting teachers, including an annual three-week Chittamani Tara retreat, and the centre also runs pujas, a public library and membership for regular supporters.

courses.title: Chittamani Tara Retreat 2026
courses.description: A three-week residential retreat in the practice of Chittamani Tara, opening with two days of guidance from Geshe Jampa Tharchin and closing with a fire puja and self-initiation. The centre plans to hold it at the same time every year for ten years. Meant for those who have received the empowerment.
courses.price: $1980 for 21 days, including all meals and retreat materials; accommodation extra (Retreat Hut $50, Camping/Caravan $25, Shared space in Community Hall $35 per night)

courses.title: 7-Day Teaching & Meditation Retreat with Venerable Tenzin Tsapel
courses.description: The centre's summer retreat, led by a former resident teacher, on Lama Tsongkhapa's advice to a disciple about bodhichitta, compassion and wisdom, with daily teaching and meditation. Open to everyone.
courses.price: $580 (includes all meals and retreat materials; accommodation extra)

courses.title: Mahamudra Retreat – The Great Seal
courses.description: Ten days of teaching and meditation with Geshe Jampa Tharchin on the Gelug and Kagyu approach to Mahamudra, looking at the conventional and ultimate nature of one's own mind through analytical and settling meditation. Taught with an interpreter.
courses.price: $850 (includes all meals and retreat materials; accommodation extra)

courses.title: FPMT Basic Program
courses.description: A five-year, twelve-subject study course in sutra and tantra devised by Lama Zopa Rinpoche, taught by Geshe Jampa Tharchin with discussion groups, homework, short retreats and an exam or presentation for each subject. The second cycle has begun with the Middle Length Lamrim on Wednesday evenings and teaching weekends.

courses.title: Membership
courses.description: Supporting membership at four levels, from a yearly Friend subscription to weekly or yearly giving that includes free classes and, at the higher levels, weekend retreats with Geshe Tharchin.
courses.price: Friends : $108.00 NZD – yearly; Supporter : $780.00 NZD – yearly or $15.00 NZD – weekly; Bodhisattva : $1,560.00 NZD – yearly or $30.00 NZD – weekly; Wishfulfilling Jewel : $2,600.00 NZD – yearly or $50.00 NZD – weekly

free_resources.title: Sunday Meditation Class
free_resources.description: A weekly Sunday morning teaching and guided meditation with Geshe Jampa Tharchin for all levels, given by donation at the centre and streamed live, followed by a shared vegetarian lunch.

free_resources.title: Visit the centre
free_resources.description: Visitors may sit in Nalanda Hall, walk around the stupa and gardens, watch the sunset from the pagoda and browse the library and shop, keeping five simple ethical guidelines while on the land.
